Do you have any gluten-free cakes?

Yes! Our gluten-free vanilla and chocolate layer cakes are baked fresh with almond flour and are just as fluffy as our classic recipes. Just add "gluten-free" as a note when you order so our kitchen keeps it separate from wheat flour.

Can you make a vegan cake for a birthday party?

Absolutely — our vegan chocolate and lemon cakes use flax eggs and oat milk, and taste every bit as rich as the originals. Give us 48 hours' notice for a custom vegan order so we can plan kitchen time separately.

I have a severe nut allergy, is that safe here?

We take nut allergies seriously: our standard cakes are nut-free, but our kitchen does handle almond flour for gluten-free orders on separate days. Let us know about the allergy when ordering and we'll flag your cake for extra care and clean equipment.

How much notice do you need for a wedding cake?
For wedding cakes we recommend booking at least 6 weeks ahead, especially during spring and summer wedding season. That gives us time for a tasting session and any custom design work.

What sizes do your cakes come in?

Our round layer cakes come in 6-inch (serves 8-10), 8-inch (serves 14-16), and 10-inch (serves 22-25). We also do tiered cakes for larger events — just tell us your headcount and we'll recommend a size.

Do you deliver, or is it pickup only?
We offer both! Pickup is free from our shop, and local delivery within 10 miles is $15, or free for orders over $150. Delivery slots need to be booked at least 24 hours in advance.

Our everyday cupcake case includes classic vanilla, double chocolate, red velvet, and lemon blueberry. We rotate seasonal flavors monthly, so ask what's featured this week too!

How should I store a cake I just picked up?

Buttercream cakes are best kept at room temperature for up to 2 days in a cool spot away from sunlight, or refrigerated for up to 5 days — just let it sit out for 20-30 minutes before serving so it softens. Fresh cream or fruit-filled cakes should always be refrigerated.

Can I cancel or change my order?

You can change or cancel a standard order free of charge up to 48 hours before pickup. Custom and wedding cake orders require 7 days' notice for changes since ingredients are pre-ordered for your design.

Yes, our dairy-free chocolate cake uses coconut cream frosting and is a customer favorite — many people can't tell it's dairy-free at all. Let us know at checkout and we'll route it to our allergen-safe prep station.
